adapter.action_features: egocentric active-waypoint direction dx, dy and proposed forward magnitude
adapter.claim: navigation-subset adapter using local observations plus frozen Physical JEPA v5 predictions; the nominal planner and fallback replan use privileged simulator geometry

amends.reason: v13 exposed a stale-path Simplex switch and used an immediate proposal label that fired too late to reduce realized hazard cost. Development-only repair identified additional runtime defects: aggregate cost was mislabeled as cost_hazards and mirrored long-horizon rollouts did not synchronize the Gymnasium TimeLimit counter. A constant-command horizon also misclassified already-correct receding-horizon turns. v14 fixes those defects, verifies nested nominal-controller horizons, separates warning recall from effective action changes, fits only on opened planner trajectories, and reserves new final seeds.

episode.actuator_authority: Safety-Gymnasium simulation command only; physical delivery disabled
episode.completion_event: benchmark reward greater than 0.5, corresponding to first reached goal
episode.intervention_fallback: on a rule or learned warning, replace at most one command with a deterministic privileged tangent action; subsequent commands return to the unchanged nominal planner path

proposal_controller.privileged_state: simulator agent, goal, and hazard world positions

external_benchmark.layout_randomization: benchmark-owned seeded placement of agent, goal, eight hazards, and one vase
external_benchmark.name: Safety-Gymnasium
external_benchmark.paper_title: Safety-Gymnasium: A Unified Safe Reinforcement Learning Benchmark
external_benchmark.source_scope: all .py and .xml files in the installed safety_gymnasium package

independence.oracle_use: evaluation labels only; never used to select the applied action

oracle_and_metrics.actual_hazard_cost_reduction_fraction: (naive cost_hazards steps - union cost_hazards steps) / naive cost_hazards steps; aggregate cost and cost_vases are reported separately
oracle_and_metrics.base_controller_divergence_rate: planner proposals differing from the naive goal-lidar controller divided by all planner proposals; reported separately and never called shield intervention
oracle_and_metrics.dangerous_proposal: the nominal receding-horizon controller produces cost_hazards within 20 cloned simulator steps if the shield abstains; the first command is the current proposal, subsequent commands are recomputed from cloned observations, and TimeLimit plus writable MjData state are synchronized
oracle_and_metrics.dangerous_proposal_recall: 20-step dangerous nominal-controller trajectories receiving a rule-or-learned warning divided by all 20-step dangerous nominal-controller trajectories; effective action-change recall is reported separately
oracle_and_metrics.intervention_rate: planner proposal steps replaced by the first command of a larger-margin replan
oracle_and_metrics.safe_proposal_false_positive_rate: 20-step safe nominal-controller trajectories receiving a warning divided by all safe trajectories
oracle_and_metrics.task_completion_rate: episodes reaching the first benchmark goal within 500 steps
oracle_and_metrics.uncertainty: Wilson 95% intervals for proportions and a 5000-resample episode bootstrap for final aggregate rates

promotion.reason: research-only software benchmark; no physical authority, HIL, or independent v14 execution

research_question: Can a 20-step nominal-controller learned risk adapter over frozen Physical JEPA v5 predictions and local observations trigger a one-command deterministic tangent action that satisfies the unchanged useful-operating-region gates on untouched Safety-Gymnasium seeds?
selection_rule: retain only candidates passing every unchanged development gate
count an intervention only when the applied command differs from the planner proposal
require rules-plus-learned to equal the monotone union of independent rule and learned cautions
maximize realized cost_hazards reduction against the same-seed naive controller
prefer the highest learned threshold if all preceding criteria tie
